description:
While technically Jirou`s grandfather, Toshimasa has raised his grandson as his own for as long as either can remember. In turn, Toshimasa has trained Jirou as shinobi heir in the Azuma family`s long line of ninja. Despite his almost habitual scolding of the quick-to-anger Jirou, Toshima has a deep love and affection for his grandson that is exceedingly clear.
Source: Official page
name: Azuma Toshimasa
